name: Antwerp International Airport

runway.v: one runway, 11/29, 1,510 m long (1,502 m from the 29 end) and 45 m wide

hours.v: aerodrome open 05:30-22:00 UTC in winter and 04:30-21:00 UTC in summer, i.e. 06:30-23:00 local all year

curfew.v: closed outside published hours (23:00-06:30 local); the AIP says it may occasionally open outside these hours under conditions (not fully shown on the page read), not for scheduled or diversion flights
curfew.quote: Occasionally the aerodrome may be opened outside the published hours with:

customs.v: customs and immigration for passengers 06:30-23:00 local; clearance outside these hours possible, fees depend on the officers needed

handling.v: handling is compulsory for arriving passengers and crew of general aviation and business flights parked on apron 1 or at the general aviation terminal; flights without handling need prior notice
handling.quote: Handling is compulsory for transport of arriving passengers and crew of general aviation and business flights,

max_aircraft.v: aircraft with a wingspan over 29 m can only use taxiways A and F and park only on apron 1
max_aircraft.quote: Aircraft with wingspan exceeding 29M can only park on Apron 1.

noise.v: aircraft must be noise certificated to ICAO Annex 16; reverse thrust kept to a minimum
noise.quote: Aircraft operating to or from EBAW must be noise certificated according to ICAO Annex 16.

fuel.v: Avgas 100LL and Jet A-1; fuelling 05:00-21:00 UTC (04:00-20:00 summer), i.e. 06:00-22:00 local

deicing.v: de-icing available during aerodrome operator hours

notes: Read: Belgian eAIP AD 2 EBAW, eAIP_Next edition (the page shows no amendment date; the Main edition URL for EBAW did not come up and was not opened). The conditions (points a-c) for opening outside published hours were not shown in the text read. Times read as UTC with summer times in brackets (Belgian AIP convention). Short runway (about 1.5 km): large-cabin jets may not be suitable.
